#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline replay auditor for a small SIP identity boundary (Boundary Profile 1).

Reads one JSON envelope from stdin, writes one JSON document to stdout.
Never opens a socket; purely local, deterministic replay of synthetic records.
"""

import hashlib
import json
import re
import sys

MAX_INPUT_BYTES = 33554432
MAX_WIRE_TOTAL = 8388608
MAX_WIRE_CHARS = 131072
MAX_EVENTS = 10000
ANON = "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"


class EnvError(Exception):
    """Invalid envelope: no stdout, exit 2."""


class FieldError(Exception):
    """Section 3 field grammar error (stage 'fields')."""


class SyntaxError_(Exception):
    """Stage 'syntax'."""


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# character classes
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
ASCII_LETTERS = frozenset("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ")
DIGITS = frozenset("0123456789")
LDH = ASCII_LETTERS | DIGITS | frozenset("-")
USER_CHARS = ASCII_LETTERS | DIGITS | frozenset("-_.!~*'()")
HEXDIG = frozenset("0123456789abcdefABCDEF")
TOKEN_CHARS = ASCII_LETTERS | DIGITS | frozenset("-.!%*_+`'~")
TOKEN_BYTES = frozenset(b"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
                        b"0123456789-.!%*_+`'~")
WS_BYTES = frozenset(b" \t")

TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9\-.!%*_+`'~]+\Z")
CALLID_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9\-_.@]{1,64}\Z")
ID_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_\-]{0,31}\Z")
TAGREST_RE = re.compile(
    r"[ \t]*;[ \t]*tag[ \t]*=[ \t]*([A-Za-z0-9\-.!%*_+`'~]{1,32})\Z", re.I)
CSEQ_RE = re.compile(r"([0-9]{1,10})[ \t]+(INVITE|MESSAGE)\Z")
CL_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9]{1,10}\Z")
CL_VALUE_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9]{1,10}\Z")

# header-block bytes: HTAB, CR, LF, SP .. '~'
HEADTBL = bytes(1 if (b == 9 or b == 10 or b == 13 or 32 <= b <= 126) else 0
                for b in range(256))

COMPACT = {"f": "from", "t": "to", "i": "call-id", "l": "content-length"}
REQUIRED = ("from", "to", "call-id", "cseq", "content-length")
